name: Linnea Holm
bio: Linnea Holm edits Halftone. She spent eleven years as a picture editor before taking the masthead.

name: Dessie Okonkwo
bio: Dessie Okonkwo reports on migration and borders. She has filed from fourteen countries for Halftone.

name: Rafael Viana
bio: Rafael Viana covers budgets, procurement and the slow parts of government.

name: Mira Halvorsen
bio: Mira Halvorsen writes about infrastructure, from undersea cable to municipal software.

name: Soo-jin Pae
bio: Soo-jin Pae reports on clinics, caregiving and the economics of both.

name: Arun Pelletier
bio: Arun Pelletier has photographed for Halftone since the first issue.
